module: Settings telemetry tracker: records the game's declared settings (settings.impl.defaults) with their current value and default value, to read framerate and crashes alongside what the player asked for. Local addresses, paths and user-created lists/presets are excluded. A change is reported at the next startup; an unchanged set is resent every surveyIntervalHours (7 days by default).
notes: Settings never reported: IngameConsoleLogBlacklist/Whitelist, WinConsoleLogBlacklist/Whitelist, mpCustomServiceURL, protocols_motionSim_address, protocols_outgauge_address, rallyCodriverVoicepackMRU, shaderGenCachePath, userColorPresets, userPaintPresets.

Change detection uses a SHA-256 of a canonical serialization (sorted keys) of the settings and defaults; the fingerprint is stored with the last survey in surveys/settingsSurvey.json (its modification date is the send date).
The event is called "settings" (surveyVersion 2) and contains settings and defaults.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on load: switches to manual unload, collects the settings and sends the survey if it is due or if the settings have changed.
